title: Electric Kiln Firing Service
pay_text: Pay per item at drop-off or monthly invoice
summary: Drop off bisque and glaze ware for firing in Skutt electric kilns to cone 06 (bisque) or cone 6 (glaze). Available to all potters; submit work through Google form.
how_to_join: Submit work via Google form and drop off during open hours
source_quote: We offer outside firings in our electric kilns. We have 4 Skutt kilns, firing to mid-range temperatures.
evidence_sentence: The page offers outside firings in Skutt kilns at mid-range temperatures, with per-item pricing.
